item.title: Heredoc in Ruby
item.description:
Formatting multiline text in code using heredoc is far from unusual in scripting languages. Creating a separate variable just to pass it into a method is redundant in most cases. To avoid this in Ruby, you can use a heredoc directly inside a method call.

You can check the documentation for all usage options. What I especially love about this approach is that you can chain formatting methods directly onto the heredoc and even pass multiple blocks sequentially.
